Every state above has four implicit sub-states
required by 11.4: loading, empty, error and stale.
They are declared here rather than drawn on each of
the 24 states, which would quadruple the diagram for
no analytical gain. Entering or leaving a sub-state is
not a navigation transition and does not change the
Reached when the server refuses a resource the
role may not read (2.3.7). The interface never
decides this — it only displays the refusal.
v0.9 additions. 11.3.20: the Report a Site screen requires a
pest type before its other fields activate, because the pest
type decides which fields 5.1.16 makes mandatory.
11.3.21: the Report Review screen offers REFERRAL, not work-order
creation, when the pest class is Wildlife (8.1.14, 8.1.15).
